$note: 田宅宮（2026-10-12）：太陽.田宅。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 田宅宮 p.556–560。火災、水災、孝服、血光、兵災、官非、倒閉一類斷語不用；風水不用（近「化解」）；添丁、天喜紅鸞、天巫、天刑等不用；要分日夜生、廟陷嘅條文暫不用。

rules.text: 太陽光熱充足，你有祖業，只是不容易守住，任職的機構也容易變更。
rules.en: Tai Yang shines strongly: there is family property, though it is hard to hold on to, and your workplace tends to change.

rules.text: 太陽光熱不足，你沒有祖業可靠，住處和工作環境常有變動，心裡也有浮動不安之感。
rules.en: Tai Yang shines weakly: there is no family property to lean on, home and workplace change often, and you feel unsettled.

rules.text: 太陽與巨門相對，即使見吉，你在產業上也多爭奪。
rules.en: With Tai Yang facing Ju Men, property brings contention even with good signs.

rules.text: 太陽化忌，你的祖業難守，事業根基也較難建立。
rules.en: Tai Yang in Hindrance: inherited property is hard to keep, and a solid base for your career is hard to build.
